'''Selro''' was a [[Gender/Legends|Male]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Private/Legends|private]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] stationed on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. In [[3643 BBY]], he asked a passerby to deal with a potential [[rakghoul]] release situation at the [[Project Quell]] [[Project Quell Research Lab|Research Lab]].
